titulo.alumno: A new plan · Delays and changes of plan

intro: Part 3: a new plan. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A delay notice gives the affected service, the reason if it is known and the alternative. «På grund af» is followed by a noun; «fordi» introduces a clause with a verb.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
